description: Author a BRANCH (SubSequence) on a campaign: when something happens to a lead, stop their sequence or jump them to another step. 🔴 AUTHORING ONLY — NOTHING EXECUTES A BRANCH YET. Adding one changes what nothing does today; execution ships in a later slice behind the first-send gate. Tell your human that rather than reporting the sequence as "now branching". TRIGGERS (exactly four): `classification` = the AI verdict on an inbound reply; `reply_text` = a literal string in the reply body; `unresponsive` = no reply after N days; `bounced` = a bounce of a given severity. ⚠️ There is NO `click` trigger and NO `open` trigger, for DIFFERENT reasons: `open` is excluded permanently (Apple MPP fires opens with no human involved, so it is noise), while `click` is merely deferred — campaign-level stop-on-click ALREADY works via the campaign's `stop_condition`, so if a human asks to "stop on click", set that instead of reporting it impossible. 🔴 `match` IS A VALIDATED AST, NOT A STRING. Never send "verdict == human" or a regex — send a tree: {"op":"eq","field":"verdict","value":"human"}. Combine with {"op":"and"|"or","nodes":[…]} or {"op":"not","node":{…}}. An unknown operator, field or extra key is REJECTED (422), not ignored. 🔴 `{}` IS REFUSED because it means MATCHES NOTHING (it is the column default, so a half-written row stays inert). To fire on EVERY occurrence send {"op":"always"}. FIELDS BY TRIGGER: classification→`verdict` (eq/in; one of human, outreach_reply, auto_reply, bounce — `warmup` is deliberately not branchable); reply_text→`text` (contains/not_contains/starts_with/equals; a literal, case-insensitive, NEVER a pattern); unresponsive→`days` (gte, 1-365); bounced→`severity` (eq/in; permanent or temporary). ACTIONS: `stop` (action_arg {}) or `jump_to_step` (action_arg {"step_index": n} — the step must already exist or you get a 422). `enrol_campaign` does not exist here. Allowed while the campaign is ACTIVE — a branch re-aims no lead's current position, so unlike editing a step it does not need a pause.

action.description: 'stop' ends this lead's sequence; 'jump_to_step' re-aims it.

action_arg.description: {} for stop; {"step_index": n} for jump_to_step (the step must exist).

enabled.description: Default true. false authors the rule without arming it.

match.description: The condition, as a TREE. e.g. {"op":"contains","field":"text","value":"not interested"}. {} is refused; use {"op":"always"} for every occurrence.

trigger.description: What to watch. No `click`/`open` — see the tool description; for stop-on-click use the campaign's stop_condition instead.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_add_campaign_branch
